name: syntax-hub
description: SyntaxHub - Monorepo for AI-powered code analysis platform with client, server, and AI services

scripts.dev:services: cd services && (.venv\Scripts\python main.py || .venv/bin/python main.py || python main.py)
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install && cd services && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
